nodes.description: Primary storage struct holding epoch, balance, provider and account mappings.
DAIQIP-3 storage: coupon expirations per account and expiring coupons per epoch.
DAIQIP-6 storage: TWAP price stored per epoch.
DAIQIP-8 storage: Era status and start time.
Caller address supplied by the transaction, fully attacker controllable.
Block timestamp used for epoch timing, miner manipulable.
Bonding.deposit: pulls DAIQ from caller and increments staged balance.
Bonding.withdraw: transfers DAIQ out to caller then decrements staged balance.
Bonding.bond: moves caller staged balance into bonded state.
Bonding.unbond: converts bonded DAIQ back into staged balance.
Bonding.unbondUnderlying: unbond by underlying value.
Bonding.bondFromPool: pool-only bonding on behalf of an account.
Bonding.bondInternal: internal bonding math and balance updates.
Bonding.step: snapshot total bonded and increment epoch.
Market.purchaseCoupons: burn DAIQ debt and mint coupons plus premium.
Market.redeemCoupons (2-arg): redeem coupons to DAIQ after penalty.
Market.redeemCoupons (3-arg): redeem coupons with slippage protection.
Market.updateCoupons: migrate legacy coupons to DAIQIP-3 with bonus.
Market.couponRedemptionPenalty: compute penalty applied on coupon redemption.
Market.couponPremium: compute premium for coupon purchase from TWAP.
Market.step: expire coupons for current epoch.
Market.expireCouponsForEpoch: expire coupons and reconcile redemption pool.
Comptroller.mintToAccount: mint DAIQ to an account and increase debt.
Comptroller.burnFromAccount: pull DAIQ in, burn it and reduce debt.
Comptroller.redeemToAccount: transfer DAIQ out and decrement redeemable.
Comptroller.increaseSupply: distribute new supply to pool, treasury, redeemable and bonded.
Comptroller.resetDebt: cap debt at the target debt ratio.
Comptroller.balanceCheck: invariant that contract DAIQ >= bonded+staged+redeemable.
Comptroller.mintToBonded: split new supply among pool, treasury and DAO.
Comptroller.mintToDAO: mint DAIQ to the DAO (this contract).
Comptroller.mintToPool: mint DAIQ to the pool address.
Comptroller.mintToTreasury: mint DAIQ to the treasury multisig.
Comptroller.mintToRedeemable: mint DAIQ held for coupon redemption.
Regulator.step: capture oracle price and act on expansion/debt/neutral.
Regulator.growSupply: increase supply proportional to price delta.
Regulator.shrinkSupply: increase debt proportional to price delta.
Regulator.oracleCapture: read TWAP price from oracle with bootstrapping fallbacks.
Govern.vote: cast governance vote weighted by bonded stake.
Govern.commit: upgrade implementation after quorum of votes.
Govern.emergencyCommit: upgrade implementation with super majority and delay.
Govern.canPropose: check caller holds enough stake to propose.
Implementation.initialize: one-time seeding of DAI and DAIQ incentives.
Implementation.advance: runs all step functions for an epoch.
Implementation.requestDAI: lottery-only vault transaction to transfer DAI.
Upgradeable.upgradeTo: set new implementation and delegatecall initialize.
Upgradeable.setImplementation: write implementation address to storage slot.
Setters.incrementBalanceOf: add to account balance and total supply.
Setters.decrementBalanceOf: subtract from account balance and total supply.
Setters.incrementBalanceOfCoupons: add coupons, set expiration and expiring total.
Setters.decrementBalanceOfCoupons: subtract coupons and update expiring total.
Setters.incrementTotalBonded: increase total bonded.
Setters.decrementTotalBonded: decrease total bonded.
Setters.incrementTotalDebt: increase total debt.
Setters.decrementTotalDebt: decrease total debt.
Setters.incrementTotalRedeemable: increase total redeemable.
Setters.decrementTotalRedeemable: decrease total redeemable.
Setters.expireCoupons: reduce total coupons by expiring amount.
Setters.setEra: set Era status and start.
Setters.adjustPeriod: adjust epoch duration based on price.
Setters.storePrice: store oracle price for an epoch.
Setters.snapshotTotalBonded: record total supply as bonded for current epoch.
Setters.placeLock: lock voter until candidate period ends.
Setters.unfreeze: set fluidUntil to the lockup epoch.
Bootstrapper.step: compute bootstrapping incentives and distribute DAI/DAIQ.
Setters.initializeEpochs: set epoch start from block.timestamp.
Setters.incrementEpoch: advance epoch counter and start time.
Setters.transfer: disabled ERC20 transfer returning false.
Setters.approve: disabled ERC20 approve returning false.
Setters.transferFrom: disabled ERC20 transferFrom returning false.
External call IDollar.transferFrom pulling DAIQ from an account (token callback risk).
External call IDollar.transfer sending DAIQ out (token callback risk).
External call IDollar.mint creating new DAIQ supply.
External call IDollar.burn destroying DAIQ.
delegatecall into candidate implementation during upgrade.

External call IVault.submitTransaction proposing a treasury DAI transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter is only used to index the balance mapping updated by incrementBalanceOf.
The amount parameter flows directly into the balance addition inside incrementBalanceOf.
The value parameter is the deposit amount consumed by the Bonding deposit entrypoint.
The candidate parameter is the implementation address consumed by the governance vote flow.
The couponEpoch parameter selects the coupon bucket for redemption.
The couponAmount parameter is the exact coupon quantity redeemed.
The dollarAmount parameter is the DAIQ debt burned by purchaseCoupons.
The expirationPeriod parameter sets the coupon expiry during purchaseCoupons.
The minOutput parameter is the slippage guard unique to the 3-arg redeemCoupons.
The newImplementation parameter is the delegatecall target set by upgradeTo.
The recipient parameter is the DAI payee encoded in the lottery vault request.
The destination parameter is encoded into the external vault transaction payload.
The vote parameter selects the approve/reject branch inside vote.
The price parameter is the oracle value processed by Regulator.step.
The bonded local is the vote weight recorded in vote.
The staged local is the multiplication/division result computed by unbond.
The balance local is the bonded share produced by bondInternal.
The newSupply local is the delta distributed by growSupply.
The totalDebt local participates in the allocation arithmetic of increaseSupply.
The totalRedeemable local is compared with coupons inside increaseSupply.
The totalCoupons local defines the redeemable shortfall computed in increaseSupply.
The price local is the oracle value driving the Regulator.step branch.
The delta local is the limited supply change applied by growSupply.
The burnAmount local reduces the coupon payout in redeemCoupons.
The redeemAmount local is the output amount of redeemCoupons.
The incentive local is the advance amount distributed by Bootstrapper.step.
The expiredAmount local records the coupons retired by expireCouponsForEpoch.
